field.label: Enable EasyTier
field.help: Enable or disable the EasyTier service.

field.label: Network Name
field.help: Name of the EasyTier virtual network. Nodes with the same network name and secret will join the same network.

field.label: Network Secret
field.help: Secret key for the network. Only nodes with the same name and secret can communicate.

field.label: Hostname
field.help: Optional hostname for this node in the EasyTier network.

field.label: IPv4 Address
field.help: Virtual IPv4 address for this node (CIDR format, e.g., 10.144.144.1/24). Leave blank for DHCP.

field.label: Use DHCP
field.help: Automatically assign an IPv4 address from the virtual DHCP server.

field.label: Default Protocol
field.help: Default protocol for listeners and connections.

field.label: Listeners
field.help: Listener URLs, one per line (e.g., udp://0.0.0.0:11010). Comma-separated also accepted.

field.label: Peer Nodes
field.help: Peer URLs to connect to, one per line (e.g., udp://192.168.1.1:11010). Comma-separated also accepted.

field.label: Proxy Networks
field.help: Networks to proxy in CIDR format, one per line (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24). Comma-separated also accepted.

field.label: RPC Portal
field.help: Address and port for the management RPC portal (default: 127.0.0.1:15888).

field.label: External Node
field.help: URL of an external node to use as a public relay server.

field.label: Relay All Peer RPC
field.help: Allow this node to relay RPC traffic for all peers.

field.label: Relay Network Whitelist
field.help: Comma-separated list of network names allowed to relay through this node.

field.label: Disable P2P
field.help: Disable peer-to-peer connections, only use relay.

field.label: Disable UDP Hole Punching
field.help: Disable UDP hole punching for NAT traversal.

field.label: Multi-Thread
field.help: Use multi-threaded runtime for better performance.

field.label: Latency First
field.help: Prefer lower latency routes over higher bandwidth routes.

field.label: Enable Exit Node
field.help: Allow this node to act as an exit node for internet traffic.

field.label: No TUN Device
field.help: Run without creating a TUN device (useful for relay-only or SOCKS5 mode).

field.label: SOCKS5 Portal
field.help: Address and port for SOCKS5 proxy portal (e.g., 127.0.0.1:1080).

field.label: Disable Symmetric NAT Hole Punching
field.help: Disable symmetric NAT hole punching for NAT traversal.

field.label: Disable IPv6
field.help: Disable IPv6 support in EasyTier.

field.label: Private Mode
field.help: Enable private mode to prevent this node from being discovered by other networks.
